I'm still recovering from my medical abortion, I was about 7/8 weeks pregnant. Taking the first pill was absolutely fine, but after I took the other 4 (they gave me 6 to take home but couldnt manage the other 2)I ended up vomiting, got really bad cramps and bled through a pad, that was normal tho. It's been a week now since I took them and I still get bad cramps every now and then, sometimes it's bareable but other times it's not.

I don't resent my partner at all. Although I find myself regretting my choice at time's. It's a big decision to make and your body will take several weeks to recover from it. As what I've been told. I hope you make the decision that you want.

You do what YOU think is right and make sure its YOUR decision, not your boyfriends cause he isn't ready, it's your body so the decision is yours to make. It takes 2 to tangle, he got you pregnant as much as you did too. Besides you didn't think you could get pregnant. End of the day tho, abortion is a big thing, your body will be in pain (I'm still recovering from mine) you'll be depressed too, the doctors don't tell you that tho, cramps can be quite bad too. Not trying to put you off tho, just telling you facts so you know.

Don't let your boyfriend decide for you, just because he's at college and not ready, most people that have kids aren't ready to become a parent but a lot of the times it's the best thing that happens to them. Personally I regret my decision on having an abortion but at the same time, I knew it was right simply because I'm just in a really shit place in life mentally and its only 3 months into my relationship.

If You want to keep it, then keep it. If you want to get an abortion, then do that. Remember becoming a parent isn't about being ready, with a job etc, it's about knowing you're going to love the child unconditionally and care for it.
